traits.name: Verdant Burst
traits.text: As vine leshy, except plants regain 3d8 (3d8) Hit Points and the area sprouts seaweed instead of vines.

traits.name: Change Shape
traits.text: ⬻ (concentrate, polymorph, primal, transmutation); As vine leshy, except the seaweed leshy transforms into a patch of seaweed.

traits.name: Sea Spray
traits.text: A seaweed leshy's water jet has enough salt in it to temporarily impair their target's vision. On a hit, the target must succeed at a DC 20 Fortitude save or be dazzled for 1 minute or until it spends 3 Interact actions wiping the salt out of its eyes. On a critical hit, a target that fails its Fortitude save is also blinded for 1 round.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ seaweed strand +11 (agile, finesse, reach 10 feet); Damage 1d8+4 (1d8+4) bludgeoning

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ water jet +11 (range increment 30 feet); Damage 1d8+4 (1d8+4) bludgeoning plus sea spray
